name: factor_approach_accel_facing
description: Identifies approach behavior using positive approach speed coupled with self_facing_other and acceleration, combining [Social]+[Motion(Self)] features with temporal trends.
code:
_P0 = 1.0
_P1 = 1.0
_P2 = 0.1
i_approach_speed = idx.get('approach_speed', -1)
i_self_facing_other = idx.get('self_facing_other', -1)
i_acceleration = idx.get('acceleration', -1)
i_dist_to_other = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
if i_approach_speed < 0 or i_self_facing_other < 0 or i_acceleration < 0 or i_dist_to_other < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    mean_approach_spd = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_approach_speed], axis=1)
    mean_facing = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_self_facing_other], axis=1)
    last_accel = windows[:, -1, i_acceleration]
    mean_dist = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_dist_to_other], axis=1)
    accel_boost = np.where(last_accel > _P2, 1.0 + _P1 * last_accel, 1.0)
    _result = _P0 * mean_approach_spd * mean_facing * accel_boost * (1.0 - mean_dist)

name: factor_explore_object_dist_approach
description: Explore object characterized by close proximity to other mouse and low approach speed over time.
code:
_P0 = 1.0
_P1 = 0.5
_P2 = 1.0
i_dist = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
i_approach = idx.get('approach_speed', -1)
if i_dist < 0 or i_approach < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    mean_dist = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_dist], axis=1)
    mean_approach = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_approach], axis=1)
    base = _P0 * (1.0 - mean_dist) * (1.0 - mean_approach)
    _result = np.where(mean_dist < _P1, base * _P2, base)

name: factor_explore_object_accel_dist
description: Explores object by combining low acceleration (stable movement) with low distance to other, using temporal std of acceleration and mean of distance.
code:

_P1 = 0.3
_P2 = 1.0
_P3 = 0.5
i_accel = idx.get('acceleration', -1)
i_dist = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
if i_accel < 0 or i_dist < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    std_accel = np.std(windows[:, :, i_accel], axis=1)
    mean_dist = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_dist], axis=1)
    score = _P0 * (1.0 - std_accel) * (1.0 - mean_dist)
    _result = np.where(mean_dist < _P1, score * _P2, score * _P3)

name: factor_explore_object_body_vel_dist
description: Explore object factor combining body velocity variability and distance to other mouse, using cross-group [Motion(Self)]+[Social] features.
code:
_P0 = 1.0
_P1 = 0.5
_P2 = 2.0
i_body_vel_x = idx.get('body_vel_x', -1)
i_body_vel_y = idx.get('body_vel_y', -1)
i_dist = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
if i_body_vel_x < 0 or i_body_vel_y < 0 or i_dist < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    body_vel_x_vals = windows[:, :, i_body_vel_x]
    body_vel_y_vals = windows[:, :, i_body_vel_y]
    vel_range = np.ptp(body_vel_x_vals, axis=1) + np.ptp(body_vel_y_vals, axis=1)
    dist_vals = windows[:, -1, i_dist]
    base = _P0 * vel_range * (1.0 - dist_vals)
    _result = np.where(dist_vals > _P1, base, base * _P2)

name: factor_explore_object_vel_y_dist
description: Explore object detection using body vertical velocity combined with distance to other mouse, capturing vertical movement patterns during object investigation
code:

    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    vel_y_mean = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_body_vel_y], axis=1)

    dist_last = windows[:, -1, i_dist]
    vel_activity = _P0 * np.abs(vel_y_mean) + _P1 * vel_y_range
    _result = np.where(dist_last > _P2, vel_activity, vel_activity * 0.5)

    _result = np.where(dist < _P1, base * _P2, base)

name: factor_explore_object_body_axis_align_dist
description: Identifies exploration when the mouse aligns its body axis towards the other mouse while maintaining close proximity.
code:
_P0 = 1.0
_P1 = 0.5
_P2 = 2.0
_P3 = 0.4
i_body_axis_align = idx.get('body_axis_align', -1)
i_dist = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
if i_body_axis_align < 0 or i_dist < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    mean_axis_align = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_body_axis_align], axis=1)
    mean_dist = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_dist], axis=1)
    proximity = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - mean_dist / _P1)
    base = _P0 * np.power(mean_axis_align, _P2) * proximity
    _result = np.where((mean_axis_align > _P3) & (mean_dist < _P1), base * 2.0, base)

name: factor_explore_object_head_vel_dist
description: Explore object factor combining head velocity magnitude and distance to other. Uses temporal std of head velocity to capture focused attention and mean distance for proximity.
code:
_P0 = 1.0
_P1 = 1.0
_P2 = 0.3
i_hvx = idx.get('head_vel_x', -1)
i_hvy = idx.get('head_vel_y', -1)
i_dist = idx.get('dist_to_other', -1)
if i_hvx < 0 or i_hvy < 0 or i_dist < 0:
    _result = np.full(len(windows), np.nan)
else:
    head_speed = np.sqrt(windows[:, :, i_hvx]**2 + windows[:, :, i_hvy]**2)
    std_head_speed = np.std(head_speed, axis=1)
    mean_dist = np.mean(windows[:, :, i_dist], axis=1)
    _result = _P0 * std_head_speed * (1.0 - _P1 * mean_dist) * (mean_dist < _P2)
